selection_note: Training/validation site families were already inspected in visual-only research. The two evaluation sites below had not been collected or scored before this protocol.

model.design: GPU ridge regression on next-image delta with train-only 16-dimensional semantic PCA; compare state-only, state-plus-click-coordinates, and state-plus-click-coordinates-plus-frozen-semantic inputs
model.regularization_selection: lowest validation weighted MSE separately per model; evaluation never used for selection

success_criterion: On each held-out site, the semantic model has at least 75 percent paired correct-action wins and at least 1 percent lower weighted MSE than both coordinate-only and state-only models, and beats its swapped-action control. Missing coverage or either site failing is an overall failure.
promotion: none; synthetic one-step generated-site performance is not real-desktop transfer, Jev parity, or safety authorization
